source: NCERT Class VII, Our Environment, Geography Ch. 6.

sections.heading: 1. Natural Vegetation and Wildlife
points: **Natural vegetation** = plant life that grows on its own, without human help.
It depends mainly on **climate** — especially **temperature and rainfall** (and altitude, soil).
Three broad types by height: **forests** (enough moisture), **grasslands** (moderate rain), and **shrubs/thorny bushes** (dry areas).

sections.heading: 2. Types of Forests
points: **Tropical Evergreen (rainforests)** — hot, very wet regions (near the equator, Amazon, Western Ghats); dense, remain green all year; e.g. rosewood, ebony.
**Tropical Deciduous (monsoon forests)** — seasonal rain; trees **shed leaves** in the dry season; e.g. **teak, sal**; most useful commercially.
**Temperate Evergreen & Deciduous** — mid-latitudes (oak, pine, eucalyptus).
**Mediterranean** — dry summers, wet winters; citrus fruits.
**Coniferous (Taiga)** — cold northern regions; **evergreen, cone-bearing, needle-like leaves** (pine, fir, spruce); softwood for paper.

sections.heading: 4. Wildlife and Conservation
points: Wildlife = animals and birds in their natural habitat; India is very rich (**tiger, lion, elephant, rhino, peacock** — the national bird).
Threats: **hunting, deforestation, habitat loss**.
Conservation: **national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, biosphere reserves**, and projects like **Project Tiger**; **migratory birds** visit seasonally.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Natural vegetation depends on climate (temperature + rainfall).
Forests: tropical evergreen (rainforest), tropical deciduous (teak/sal, sheds leaves), Mediterranean, coniferous/taiga (softwood).
Tropical grassland = Savanna (Africa); temperate = Prairie (N.Am), Pampas (S.Am), Steppe (Asia), Veld (S.Africa), Downs (Australia).
Tundra = mosses/lichens (polar).
Conservation: national parks, sanctuaries, biosphere reserves, Project Tiger.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: Match temperate grasslands to regions: **Prairies (N. America), Pampas (S. America), Steppes (Central Asia), Veld (S. Africa), Downs (Australia)**.
**Savanna** = **tropical** grassland (Africa); **coniferous/taiga** = **cold** northern forest.
**Deciduous (monsoon)** forests **shed leaves** seasonally; **teak and sal** are deciduous.
Natural vegetation is governed mainly by **climate**, not soil alone.
